config.label: Path to the SQLite file that holds the memory
config.description: Path to the SQLite file that holds the memory. A leading ~/ means your home directory; a relative path depends on where the client starts the server (some start it in /), so give an absolute or ~/ path. Use ':memory:' for a store that is discarded when the process exits.

config.label: Comma-separated context domains, passed to the cross-context layer
config.description: Comma-separated context domains, passed to the cross-context layer. No tool uses that layer yet, so the value currently has no effect.
